title: Parsley Health pill button
description: A full-pill button with a medium geometric label: forest fill, a softer sage fill, a 2px forest outline, or an ochre fill, in four heights. An optional small arrow nudges 4px right on hover; fills deepen over 150ms.
notes: inside a .dark scope (nav bar, footer) primary turns bone with forest text
pass block="phone" for the original's full-width phone buttons
name: parsleyhealth-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: primary: forest fill · secondary: sage fill · outline: 2px forest ring · highlight: ochre fill

props.name: size
props.description: xs: 38px (announcement bar) · sm: 50px (nav, cards) · md: 56px · lg: 60px (sections)

props.name: arrow
props.description: a small arrow after the label that nudges right on hover

props.name: block
props.description: stretch to the full width: always, or only on phones (below lg)

props.name: type
props.description: button type when it renders a button
